entries.title: Where should a team of agents commit to a decision?
entries.summary: Comparing sequential pipelines, routing, orchestrator/workers, parallel candidates, debate and population search.
entries.detail:
The screenshot groups architectures by where alternatives are discarded. The next question is whether extra agents help a paper task enough to justify their cost. No architecture comparison has been run. Jason supplied the article URL as the source; the full article was not accessible for independent verification.

entries.title: Extracting methods, models and datasets from papers
entries.summary: Considering a PyTorch token classifier that keeps exact source spans and caches annotations when a paper is opened.
entries.detail:
Start by auditing public datasets and label definitions. PyTorch is the initial runtime candidate; ONNX or TensorRT would need a measured bottleneck and output-equivalence checks. The shared post’s latency target is not our benchmark result.

```text
      |
      v
[PyTorch token classifier]
      |
      v
[Entities + source spans]
      |
      v
[Cached annotations]
```
entries.next_check: Choose a licensed dataset, inspect labels and establish a simple extraction baseline before training.

entries.title: Qwen fine-tuning: reliable execution versus useful answers
entries.summary: On 40 selected QASPER questions, error-free episodes rose from 18/40 to 39/40 after SFT.
entries.detail:
Both checkpoints received supported-answer passes on 3/20 answerable questions in model-assisted review. The 44 demonstrations were teacher-seeded and include AI repairs. This measures the selected development workload, not general paper-research quality.

## Diagram

Assistant-authored illustration of this note.

```text
Selected QASPER questions

                    Base     SFT v5
Error-free          18/40 -> 39/40
Supported answers    3/20 ->  3/20

Execution improved
Answer-quality gain not established
```

entries.title: A small GRPO pilot and its limits
entries.summary: The restarted pilot completed nine verified optimizer updates; rollout collection timed out before update ten.
entries.detail:
A separate exploratory comparison found one complete supported answer in each arm on ten clear-reference questions. Sparse within-group reward differences and a small evaluation limit what can be concluded. The checkpoint was not promoted.
